entities.name: Cave of Light
entities.description: Structure built around the White Lacuna at the base of Taj-Nar, holy to leonin and Auriok, delivering visions from the white sun.

entities.name: White Lacuna
entities.description: One of the tunnels leading to Mirrodin's Core.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane containing the Core and lacunae.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: Place at whose base the Cave of Light stood.

entities.name: Mana Core
entities.description: Large ball of mana at the center of Mirrodin from which the suns rose.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: Cat people whose clerics, the abunas, cause the white sun to rise.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: Mirrodin people who held the Cave of Light holy.

relations.note: It stood at the base of Taj-Nar.
relations.quote: It was located at the base of Taj-Nar .
